findings.title: The alleged recursively closed and total semantic schema is neither recursively closed, type-exact, nor total
evidence: All fourteen named schemas declare closed=true and additionalProperties=false, but none defines a per-field type map.
WitnessEdge, SpanAnchor, partition contents, object-state maps, and replay objects have no closed child schema.
R10-PROBE-02/03 raised TypeError on malformed JSON.
R10-PROBE-04 accepted malformed memberIds, authoritative, ContentRef.kind, evidenceUnits, and StorageAdmission values.
R10-PROBE-06/07 accepted RequestId/ExecutionId/timestamp/cache/lifetime fields and the removed booleans inside unclosed children.
The declared unknownFieldOutcome is included in text, but the finding code returned to callers is generic E-SCHEMA.
findings.impact: Untrusted persisted JSON can crash validation or carry expressly forbidden operational identity and producer assertions inside an accepted semantic record. The EVD-02, EVD-03, and EVD-07 closure claims are false.
findings.falsifier: A repaired validator rejects every R10-PROBE-02..07 input without raising, returns a stable machine-readable outcome, and a recursive schema audit finds no object/array child without a closed typed contract.
findings.requiredChange: Define and enforce types for every field and element; add closed schemas for WitnessEdge, SpanAnchor or its canonical replacement, replay objects, partition entries, and object-state entries; scan forbidden semantic metadata/shortcuts at every semantic boundary; make all JSON paths exception-safe; return the declared outcome as structured data; retain each escape and exception as a negative fixture and mutation.

findings.title: Exact activation and complete outcome identity are bypassed by ignored memberIds, duplicate evaluations, and outcome/claim-shape mismatch
evidence: R10-PROBE-09 accepted both omitted and substituted requiredUniverse.memberIds because the field is never read.
R10-PROBE-10 accepted an exact duplicate activated evaluation after declaredCount was incremented; universe/outcome commitments deduplicate their members.
R10-PROBE-11 accepted outcome=match with claimShape=no-match and a no-match proof after recomputing the outcome-set commitment.
Direct unrecomputed substitution and omission do reject, so the missing rules are uniqueness and cross-field semantic coherence rather than the hash implementation.
findings.impact: A bundle can claim two activations while committing one set member, or commit a syntactically valid outcome that its retained proof does not establish. EVD-04's statement that duplication and substitution fail is false.
findings.falsifier: The checker derives a unique evaluation key set, rejects duplicate evaluationId/predicateId members before commitment, proves memberIds equals the canonical activated member set, and enforces an exact outcome-to-claim-shape/proof mapping; R10-PROBE-09..11 all reject by dedicated invariants.
findings.requiredChange: Bind memberIds exactly or remove the redundant field; reject duplicate activation keys before applying the set grammar; specify and enforce outcome/claim-shape compatibility; add duplicate, same-key/different-outcome, omitted memberIds, substituted memberIds, and recomputed-substitution negatives.

findings.title: Authoritative no-match does not bind a content-addressed fact partition, exact Coverage domain, or closed-set derivation
evidence: R10-PROBE-15 changed partition contents while keeping the same sha256 id, recomputed the subject set/count, and was accepted.
R10-PROBE-16 substituted coverageId independently of coverageRef and was accepted.
objectStore is only a set of claimed identifiers; neither object bytes nor a digest-to-bytes check exists.
No Coverage object or verificationRequirement is evaluated, and completeness=complete is trusted as an enum literal.
fact-plane.v1 explicitly leaves honesty of complete coverage to EVIDENCE.
findings.impact: The same factPartitionRef can support different subject universes, and a producer can assert a complete universal negative without demonstrating that its retained facts cover the exact predicate domain. This leaves the core V10 no-match obligation open.
findings.falsifier: An independent verifier resolves bytes for factPartitionRef, recomputes its digest, derives the exact subject universe and Coverage identity from those bytes plus the predicate requirement, and rejects both R10-PROBE-15 and R10-PROBE-16 without trusting completeness.
findings.requiredChange: Bind ContentRef ids to canonical retained bytes or an explicit CAS oracle; define the closed fact-partition/Coverage object and verificationRequirement; join coverageId to the resolved Coverage object's identity; derive completeness and the subject set from that object under predicate semantics; add same-id/different-bytes and mismatched-Coverage negatives.

findings.title: Relationship and host-owned adequacy checks are field-presence tests
evidence: R10-PROBE-08 accepted null endpoints and an object-valued relationKind because witness validation uses only all(k in edge ...).
The witness edge itself is not a closed record and accepts arbitrary producerDeclaredObligation metadata in R10-PROBE-06.
Direct producerDeclaredObligation is correctly rejected, but there is no host-derived proof-obligation identity or admission provenance in the bundle.
findings.impact: A relationship proof can satisfy the retained validator without naming a usable ordered edge, and producer-selected adequacy data can survive in nested proof material. EVD-05 and EVD-07 overstate mechanical proof.
findings.falsifier: A closed typed WitnessEdge schema plus host-derived obligation binding rejects R10-PROBE-06 and R10-PROBE-08, including empty/null endpoints, invalid relationKind, unknown fields, and producer-selected obligation identity.
findings.requiredChange: Define WitnessEdge as a closed typed record with canonical non-empty subject identities, a closed relation kind tied to relationSemanticsRef, and a resolvable fact ref; bind the applied proof obligation to a host-owned predicate/claim-shape derivation rather than forbidding two producer field spellings only.

findings.title: The EVIDENCE-to-retention join omits retention v6's minimum-capability and sealed/effective-capability derivations
evidence: Retention v6 validate_closure compares every proof ref's neededAtCapability with unit.requiredForCapability and effective_capability derives the current level from sealed capability and unit states.
check-evidence.py only checks one owner and closure hash; it never derives neededAtCapability.
R10-PROBE-18 accepted relabelling a verifiable predicate-semantics unit as replayable.
R10-PROBE-19 accepted that downgraded unit after its object was PURGED.
R10-PROBE-20 accepted assuranceCapability=replayable after the replay-only unit became MISSING-DEPENDENCY.
EvidenceBundle represents only assuranceCapability, not immutable sealed capability plus derived effective capability.
findings.impact: The exact reviewer-3 R3-RTV5-CE-03 downgrade can again preserve authority after required proof disappears. E12's prose contradicts both its schema and validator, and EVD-06's closure claim is false.
findings.falsifier: EVIDENCE derives proofRefs with minimum capability, passes them through retention v6's exact closure/effective-capability function, represents sealed and effective states without ambiguity, and rejects R10-PROBE-18..20 while preserving the retention v6 positive demotion fixtures.
findings.requiredChange: Consume one canonical retention derivation rather than reimplement ranks. Derive neededAtCapability for every evaluation and verdict dependency, validate exact one-unit ownership and no downgrade, recompute effective capability from all relevant unit states, and state which capability field is sealed versus current. Retain downgrade, partial, replay-loss, and sealed/effective mismatch controls.

findings.title: ReplayClosure is an asserted open bag, not an offline-resolvable typed closure
evidence: ReplayClosure closes only the two outer keys; objects[] has no schema and locallyResolvable has no boolean type.
R10-PROBE-21 accepted a truncated unresolvable object id, nested RequestId, and the truthy string 'claimed'.
R10-PROBE-20 shows the asserted closure is not joined to replay-unit availability.
findings.impact: A bundle can retain the replayable label with no resolvable derivation object, recreating the boolean-only closure class that EVIDENCE v2 claims to remove.
findings.falsifier: Every ReplayClosure object is a closed ContentRef-like record, resolves to retained bytes, maps to exactly one replay capability unit, and locallyResolvable is derived rather than asserted; R10-PROBE-20/21 reject.
findings.requiredChange: Define and enforce the exact replay-object schema, require non-empty unique full ContentRefs, verify objectStore/CAS resolution and capability-unit ownership, require all replay units AVAILABLE for effective replayable, and replace or mechanically derive locallyResolvable.

findings.title: EVD-PATCH-04 is a remaining architecture fork, not a nonblocking VERSIONING integration
evidence: evaluation-proof EP-3 and EVIDENCE verifiable no-match require historical predicate semantics to remain interpretable.

versioning-policy.v2 classifies ruleIR as AUTHOR-CUSTODY major-versioned but provides no ruleIR supportWindow, retained interpreter/evaluator custody, predicate-proof migration, or capability-demotion rule.
product-dispositions.v1 says the v1 rule IR need not be public/frozen; that does not supply historical executable semantics.
The Phase-1A author adjudication PATCH-09 and Phase-1B EVD-PATCH-04 both mark the join required and unapplied.
Retention v6 derives capability only from object availability, so an available predicateSemanticsRef can remain labelled verifiable after the host can no longer interpret its major.
findings.impact: Implementers must choose among retaining old evaluators, migrating proof/IR, promising an interpretation window, or demoting capability. Those choices change custody, compatibility, and the meaning of verifiable, so they are an architecture decision and block EVIDENCE seal.
findings.falsifier: A binding VERSIONING/EVIDENCE/RETENTION join selects one strategy, gives exact rule/policy IR identity and support/demotion semantics, and includes a cross-major fixture demonstrating either successful historical verification or deterministic demotion/refusal.
findings.requiredChange: Resolve EVD-PATCH-04 before seal: bind rule/policy IR major identity to predicateSemanticsRef, state how historical interpretation is supplied and for how long, include required evaluator/migrator objects in capability custody where applicable, and derive effective capability when the interpreter is unavailable.

postBlindComparison.reviewer3Continuity: R10-EVD-05 reproduces reviewer-3's R3-RTV5-CE-03 in the live EVIDENCE v2 validator: relabelling a verifiable dependency as replayable masks its purge. The Phase-1A retention checker rejects this in its own fixture model, but EVIDENCE does not carry that rule across the join.
postBlindComparison.identityDeferredPatch: The narrow top-level requirements of identity-contracts.evidence-requestid-closure.deferred-patch.v1 are present. Its post-integration proofText describes an exact closed semantic record, which is not true recursively.

EVD-PATCH-04.decision: A content-addressed predicateSemanticsRef establishes object identity, not future interpretability. Until an old evaluator, migration strategy, explicit support window, or deterministic capability-demotion rule is selected, verifiable has no stable cross-major meaning.

OPERABILITY-RequestId-mechanical-join.decision: Do not move EvidenceBundle from pendingCrossSurfaceClosure into mechanicallyJoined after this review.
OPERABILITY-RequestId-mechanical-join.why: Top-level requestId exclusion is mechanically shown, but recursively open witness/span/replay/partition/state structures admit RequestId and related metadata. The proposed proof text would overclaim structural absence from the exact semantic record.
OPERABILITY-RequestId-mechanical-join.narrowFutureOption: After recursive closure is repaired and its negative controls pass, promote the full EvidenceBundle join. Promoting only a narrowly labelled top-level-key exclusion would be technically true but would not discharge OPERABILITY's semantic exclusion claim.

measurementResidualsRetained: A1-RTV4-02 no-match fold/reverification cost remains unmeasured.
Capability-closure recomputation cost at realistic unit counts remains unmeasured.
assuranceLimits.designIntegrityOnly: Passing authored contracts/checkers and this static review do not qualify or demonstrate a product implementation.

positiveObservations: The independent oracle reproduced every authored positive universe, outcome-set, waiver-set, subject-set, and capability-closure commitment exactly under the live grammar.
All authored positive fixtures use full lowercase sha256 references and declare those ContentRefs resolvable in their objectStore model.
Direct outcome commitment tampering/omission, truncated/unresolvable proof refs, indeterminate-to-pass absorption, direct producer adequacy declaration, unit aliasing, and unit omission reject.
The evidence mutation self-test correctly refuses dirty base state and counts a non-applying mutation as an escape.
D9 is not enlarged, assurance remains honest, V10 remains unresolved, and CD-RT-5 remains with product authority.

finalAssessment.reason: Phase-1A acceptance would not cure the independently reproduced EVIDENCE v2 schema, activation, no-match, relationship, replay, and retention-join defects. In addition, EVD-PATCH-04 prevents the Phase-1A/EVIDENCE dependency chain from assigning a stable cross-major meaning to verifiable.
